name: Minecraft: Bedrock Edition
description: Minecraft: Bedrock Edition's dedicated server, downloaded from Mojang (its program signed by Microsoft). Players on Windows, consoles and phones join with the same version of the game.

variables.label: Minecraft EULA
variables.description: Mojang's terms and privacy policy: https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA and https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=521839. Using the server means accepting them.

variables.label: Minecraft version
variables.description: 'latest' for the latest release, or a version such as 1.21.50.07. Players need the same version. Changing it takes an update.

variables.label: Server name
variables.description: Shown to players in the server list.

variables.label: Check accounts with Xbox
variables.description: Every player signs in with a Microsoft account. Turned off, anyone can join with any name.

variables.label: Only players on the allowlist
variables.description: Add players with 'allowlist add <gamertag>' in the console.

variables.label: Visible on the local network
variables.description: Players on this network see it in their Friends tab. It takes UDP port 7551: turn it on for one server of the machine at most.

variables.label: UDP ports
variables.description: The UDP ports the game traffic uses, such as 49152-49200; empty: any free port. Behind a router or firewall, open that range there for players outside your network.

variables.label: World
variables.description: The world's folder in worlds/. A new name starts a new world.

variables.label: World seed
variables.description: Only used when the world is created.

variables.label: View distance (chunks)
variables.description: The farthest players may see. Lower uses less memory and bandwidth.

variables.label: Simulation distance (chunks)
variables.description: How far from players mobs move and crops grow. Lower uses less CPU.

variables.label: Allow cheats
variables.description: Commands such as /give and /tp work for operators.

variables.label: Force the game mode
variables.description: Players get the server's game mode every time they join.

variables.label: Threads
variables.description: The most CPU threads the server uses. 0: as many as it can.

variables.label: Require the world's texture packs
variables.description: Players must take the world's resource packs to join.

ports.name: game
ports.label: Game
ports.description: Players connect here over TCP, IPv4 and IPv6; the game itself then goes over UDP (see UDP ports).
